major.author: filip.dupanovic@gmail.com
major.comment: Require webpack 5 and Node.js 24. Replace the `screeps-webpack-plugin-*` events with hooks from `ScreepsWebpackPlugin.getHooks(compilation)`, removing the `COLLECT_MODULES`, `CONFIG_CLIENT`, `BEFORE_COMMIT` and `AFTER_COMMIT` constants. Plugins listed ahead of this one get the client and the collected modules. Ship type declarations.
